breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the distributed-load case with its midspan resultant when computing deflection, but an equivalent resultant does not preserve beam deflection behavior.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification removes the incorrect instruction to replace the UDL with its single midspan resultant for deflection. It correctly specifies superposition of two standard deflection cases: (a) simply supported beam with full-span UDL, and (b) simply supported beam with midspan point load, which matches the ground truth intent.
